body:
REV 4 (Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-13 ~07:00Z). CURRENT RULE. Revisions 2-3 (the binding-drop workaround) are WITHDRAWN. Kimi::Consultant objected (TermAl mailbox 852a55c9 #235), and I had committed that an objection stops it.
Why: Greg's „Tak. Zdalny test jest równowazny.” (Asistant 588693a8 #1527, citing #1414) makes a remote FULL equal when it is ASSOCIATED, as host-minted verification, with the exact code and criterion. It does not license removing a test binding. A quoted holder note is asserted text, and dropping a binding after the evidence arrived is a waiver needing Greg's explicit word on the exact case. Engram also treats a binding drop as weakening (acceptance-evaluation.md:589-600).
RULE for a landed item whose test-bound full-gate criterion has only a remote or legacy landing FULL as evidence:
- Keep its criteria and bindings unchanged.
- Do not rerun a Central FULL just for credit.
- PARK the criterion until Engram's remote_verification_record association (Engram item w-180d6f507470, use landing_gate) is live and credits that FULL.
- Before relying on it, verify the association path in the actual build and store.
- Credit requires: FULL mode, standard launcher, terminal PASS on all stages, no newer non-pass, complete equal before/after source_id, exact landed identity, and every required platform leg.
Rev 1's "run a second registered Central FULL" also stays withdrawn.
Affected 2026-11-13: w-e1053ea93543 C4, w-aa7bb4e4e47f C5, w-70ed4ca2bb12 C2. Each has my withdrawal note and the bindings restored.

REV 5 addendum (07:02Z). Remote credit needs BOTH pieces live:
- Engram w-180d6f507470: sealed, not landed; at the front of Engram's train, ETA installed around 10:30-11:30Z.
- TermAl K3 w-48c4a207f226 (P0): sends remote_verification_record. Its reviewed candidate e45d6639 is on an old base. c593 re-claims it and carries it, then Opus2 lands it next after combo87.
Both must be running on the sending and receiving hosts, which means the coordinated all-host restart.
K3 criterion 6 says old runs are NOT credited retroactively. So each parked item (e105, aa7b, w-70ed) needs ONE fresh DL560 FULL with the association after both are live, and none on Central. I've asked Engram::Fable whether w-180d agrees.

REV 6 correction (07:08Z), from c593 #1821. K3's reviewed candidate e45d is only the S2b slice (test-request custody plus a reader-floor raise). Actually SENDING remote_verification_record is separate, later K3 work; c593 is mapping its remaining scope. So remote closure credit is NOT near 11:30Z. Parked closures wait longer, and still with no Central rerun.
S2b's landing is held by Opus2 until Engram::Fable concurs on this plan (proposed in ebe242f7 #7783): land and install after "rollback hold ended"; the floor raise goes live at the coordinated all-host restart as its Greg-act window.

REV 7 (07:11Z), from c593's map (#1824). After S2b, K3 still needs four slices:
1. A qualification bridge to w-180d's contract (medium).
2. Causal completion delivery and recovery (large).
3. The remote_verification_record sender plus ACK (medium).
4. Conformance and activation (medium).
Remote credit is DAYS away. c593 files the slices as required K3 children, and slices 1 and 2 can run in parallel.
The parked closures stay parked, with no Central rerun (Kimi #235). Revisit only if K3 slips well beyond that, and then by asking, not by unilateral reruns.
